title: Flavor Corner-Coupling Ratio Bound and Hilbert-Schmidt Characterization
verdict_rationale: An independent decomposition gives J eigenvalues 3,0,0, hence Y eigenvalues a+2b,a-b,a-b and, for a>0, exactly -1/2 <= b/a <= 1; this supplies the continuum proof beyond the runner's finite grid. Independently, I and J-I are Hilbert-Schmidt orthogonal with squared norms 3 and 6, while the eigenvalue sum and squared sum are 3a and 3a^2+6b^2, yielding the stated Gaussian variance ratio and Q identity. Equipartition alone fixes (b/a)^2=1/2, and intersection with the PSD interval selects the positive 1/sqrt(2) branch, consistent with the note's limited characterization.
